newsitem.title: USA: Consumers extends 67 MW Mich. nuke outage.
newsitem.headline: Consumers extends 67 MW Mich. nuke outage.

text.p: Consumers Power Co's 67 megawatt Big Rock Point nuclear power unit in Charlevoix, Mich., shut last Friday, will be down for about 30 to 45 days, the company said Tuesday.
"We discovered a piece of metal in the turbine," company spokesman Tim Petrosky said, adding that operators have to remove the turbine cover to assess the damage.
Until then, he said, the restart of the unit is tentative.
Last week, after the unit was shut due to turbine vibration, the company had said it would likely restart early this week.
Consumers Power Co is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
